routes.label: Evaluate using the order of operations

question: Which of the following values is largest?
solution:
Perform multiplication before addition. Remember that multiplying by \(0\) gives \(0\), and multiplying by \(1\) leaves a number unchanged. Thus the choices have values
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{A: }&2+0+1+7=10,\\
\text{B: }&0+1+7=8,\\
\text{C: }&2+0+7=9,\\
\text{D: }&2+0+7=9,\\
\text{E: }&0.
\end{aligned}
\]
The largest value is \(10\), so the answer is \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
